conventions.commits: Conventional commits with scope (e.g., 'feat(lang): add PHP support'); signed commits with DCO
conventions.testing: Unit tests in each language module using parse_<lang> helper and tree-sitter Query API; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/ using make_test_analyzer() harness; test dimensions cover element extraction, inheritance, defuse sites, and edge cases
conventions.linting: cargo clippy with deny-level lints: undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (test-code exemptions via cfg_attr); cargo fmt --check; cargo deny check advisories licenses
conventions.error_handling: Functions return Option<T> or Vec<T>; bounds checks on source byte ranges before slicing (end <= source.len()); no unwrap/expect in production code; thiserror for error types in MCP handlers

patterns: Language module at crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/<lang>.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and optional DEFUSE_QUERY constants
Registration in get_language_info() match arm with LanguageInfo struct populated with queries and optional handler functions
Extension mapping in lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP array and language_for_extension lookup
extract_inheritance handler walks child_by_field_name('superclass') and child_by_field_name('interfaces') for base/implements clauses
DEFUSE_QUERY pattern: write.local, write.assign, writeread.update, read.usage capture groups for semantic analysis
Test coverage: parse_<lang> helper, ELEMENT_QUERY validation, inheritance extraction, defuse site detection, empty file edge case

related_issues.title: Add PHP language support via tree-sitter-php
related_issues.relevance: Primary issue: requests PHP support following Java pattern with tree-sitter-php grammar

constraints: All languages unconditionally compiled (lang-* feature gates removed); PHP must be available at runtime
tree-sitter-php must be added to workspace.dependencies in Cargo.toml with pinned version >=7 days old
LanguageInfo struct is exhaustive; every field must be populated or explicitly set to None
Query strings must be valid tree-sitter query syntax; capture names must match handler expectations
No unsafe code without SAFETY comment; no unwrap/expect in production paths
test_coverage: Existing test patterns in language modules cover: (1) ELEMENT_QUERY compilation and node matching, (2) CALL_QUERY for method/function invocation, (3) REFERENCE_QUERY for type references, (4) IMPORT_QUERY for import statements, (5) extract_inheritance for base classes and interface implementations, (6) DEFUSE_QUERY for write/read site detection, (7) extract_function_name for symbol extraction, (8) find_receiver_type for method enclosing class, (9) empty file edge case. Java and Kotlin modules show full coverage; CSS shows minimal coverage (no handlers). PHP will need at least 9 test dimensions covering all declaration kinds, inheritance patterns, and semantic sites.

library_findings.version: not yet in Cargo.toml; latest from crates.io
library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; grammar defines function_definition, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, method_declaration; base_clause and class_interface_clause for inheritance
library_findings.notes: Grammar node types confirmed via php/src/node-types.json and php/src/grammar.json from tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php repository. function_definition has 'name' field (not 'method_name'); base_clause contains _name children (not 'superclass' field); class_interface_clause contains _name children (not 'interfaces' field). Traits supported (unlike Java). No separate enum_case_declaration; enum members in enum_declaration_list.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter::Language, tree_sitter::Query, tree_sitter::QueryCursor, tree_sitter::Node; child_by_field_name(), named_child(), start_byte(), end_byte(), kind()
library_findings.notes: Used consistently across all language modules for parsing and query execution. Node bounds checks required before slicing source text.

approaches.name: Minimal PHP support (CSS-like, no handlers)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml, create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, method_declaration) and CALL_QUERY only. Register in mod.rs with all handler fields set to None. Add 'php' to EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs with extension '.php'. No DEFUSE_QUERY, no inheritance extraction, no semantic handlers.
pros: Covers basic symbol extraction for IDE use cases

approaches.name: Full PHP support with DEFUSE_QUERY only
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml. Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering all declaration kinds (function_definition, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, method_declaration), CALL_QUERY for function_call_expression and member_call_expression, DEFUSE_QUERY for local variable declarations and identifier usage. Add extract_function_name and find_receiver_type handlers. Register in mod.rs. Add 'php' to EXTENSION_MAP. No extract_inheritance handler.

approaches.name: Complete PHP support with all handlers (recommended)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml. Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, method_declaration), CALL_QUERY (function_call_expression, member_call_expression, scoped_call_expression), DEFUSE_QUERY (local variable declarations, assignments, identifier reads), and full handler functions: extract_function_name (from function_definition or method_declaration name field), find_receiver_type (walk ancestors to enclosing class/interface/trait/enum), find_method_for_receiver (verify method is inside type body), extract_inheritance (walk base_clause and class_interface_clause children for extends/implements, plus trait_use_clause for trait composition). Register in mod.rs with all fields populated. Add 'php' to EXTENSION_MAP. Comprehensive test coverage for all 9+ dimensions.
pros: Full code intelligence parity with Java/Kotlin
Handles PHP-specific features (traits, nullsafe operators in grammar)
Complete semantic analysis (def/use, method lookup, inheritance)
cons: Must handle PHP trait composition (different from Java interfaces)

recommendation: Approach 3 (Complete PHP support with all handlers). The issue explicitly requests modeling after Java, which includes extract_inheritance and full semantic handlers. PHP's trait system requires special handling (trait_use_clause in class_declaration children) that differentiates it from Java's interface-only pattern. Full implementation enables the same code-intelligence capabilities for PHP as existing languages, justifying the effort. DEFUSE_QUERY is required because semantic analysis (def/use site detection) is a core feature of aptu-coder and expected by downstream consumers; omitting it would create a second-class language integration.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @function_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
"
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (php/src/grammar.json): class_declaration has children base_clause (optional, contains 'extends' keyword followed by _name nodes) and class_interface_clause (optional, contains 'implements' keyword followed by _name nodes). Walk class_declaration.child_by_field_name('base_clause') and iterate named_child() to extract each _name node's text as 'extends <name>'. Walk class_declaration.child_by_field_name('class_interface_clause') and iterate named_child() to extract each _name node's text as 'implements <name>'. For traits: class_declaration children include trait_use_clause nodes (not a field) containing trait names; iterate children and match kind == 'trait_use_clause' to extract 'uses <trait_name>'.
